UserRegistry.title: UserRegistry
UserRegistry.description: Internal login profile registered and managed by an administrator account.

uid.description: The unique Firebase authenticated User ID.

username.description: Unique login moniker assigned to the operator.

displayName.description: The human readable name or handle of this member.

createdAt.description: ISO format string of registration time.

BookProject.title: BookProject
BookProject.description: Represents a full multi-stage book publishing project track on behalf of a specific creator.

ownerId.description: The Firebase User UID of the project owner.

projectName.description: The title or working name of the book project.

currentPhaseIndex.description: Index representing the current phase, from 0 to 9.

createdAt.description: The date or ISO string when the project was logged.

prospect.description: Prospecting and initial visit evaluation status details.

creativeBrief.description: Art design proposals and feedback loop results.

proposal.description: Service itemized offerings and budget cost calculations.

closing.description: Closing terms, finalized finances and electro-signature status.

preProduction.description: Outline chapters, team assignments, and schedules.

production.description: Progress tracking across literary drafting steps and cover issues.

printing.description: Print verification steps, shipments, and quantities.

finalArtwork.description: Softcopy delivery and award trophy parameters.

users/{userId}.description: Secure collection of custom login profiles registered and managed by an administrator account.

projects/{projectId}.description: Secure collection of custom projects tracked per user.
